heading: Insurers, TPAs and corporates
description: The organisations this hospital bills instead of the patient: insurers, third-party administrators and corporates, with their plans and rate agreements.
add: Add an insurer, TPA or corporate
empty: No insurers, TPAs or corporates yet.

create.heading: Add an insurer, TPA or corporate
create.description: The code is the hospital's own short name for it and cannot be changed later.

form.codeHint: Letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores. Unique among your organisations.
form.name: Name
form.contactHint: Someone at the organisation, not a patient.

notFound.title: Organisation not found
notFound.body: There is no such insurer, TPA or corporate at this hospital.

plans.heading: Plans
plans.description: What each plan covers, how much of a covered charge the patient pays, its limits and who is eligible.
plans.name: Plan

plan.description: Amounts are in the hospital's currency. Leave a limit empty for no limit.
plan.codeHint: Unique among this organisation's plans. It cannot be changed later.
plan.name: Name
plan.copayHint: The part of a covered charge the patient pays, 0 to 100.
plan.preAuthHint: Admissions and procedures under this plan wait for the payer's approval.
plan.waitingHint: Days after the policy starts before it pays.
plan.coverageHint: Choose whether the list below is what is left out or all that is covered.

errors.ageOrder: The oldest age cannot be below the youngest.
errors.servicesNeeded: Add at least one service, or choose to cover everything except the list.

agreements.heading: Rate agreements
agreements.description: Prices agreed with this organisation for a period. An agreement is never edited: to change a price, end it and add a new one from a later date.
agreements.name: Agreement

agreement.description: Between the two dates, the discount applies to list prices, and an agreed rate replaces the list price of its service.
agreement.name: Name
agreement.noRates: No agreed rates: only the discount applies.

errors.endBeforeStart: The last day cannot be before the first.

errors.duplicate_code: That code is already used. Choose another.
errors.version_conflict: Someone else changed this just now. What you typed is kept; check it and save again.
errors.agreement_overlap: This period overlaps another agreement with the same organisation. End that one first or choose other dates.
errors.starts_in_past: An agreement cannot start in the past.
errors.payer_archived: This organisation is archived. Restore it first.
errors.service_not_found: A service in the list no longer exists. Remove it and try again.
errors.duplicate_policy: This policy is already on the patient’s record.
errors.policy_not_active: This policy is no longer active. Choose another policy.
errors.not_submitted: This request has already been answered or withdrawn.
errors.plan_archived: This plan is archived. Choose another plan.

policy.heading: Policies
policy.empty: No insurance policy on this record.

add.title: Add an insurance policy
add.description: The organisation and plan, the number on the card and the dates it runs.

policy.validToHint: Leave empty when the policy has no end date.

end.title: End this policy?
end.description: It can no longer back a new pre-authorization. Requests already made are kept as they were.

errors.endBeforeStart: The last day is before the first.

preauth.heading: Pre-authorizations
preauth.empty: No pre-authorization requested for this patient.
preauth.needsPolicy: Add an active policy before asking a payer for approval.
preauth.treatmentHint: What the payer is asked to approve.
preauth.documentsHint: One name to a line. The files themselves are kept on the patient’s record, under Documents.
preauth.approvedHint: The limit the payer agreed to cover.

add.title: Request pre-authorization
add.description: Asks the payer of one of the patient’s active policies to approve the cost.

cancel.title: Withdraw this request?
cancel.description: The payer is no longer asked to approve it. This cannot be undone.

limit.heading: Insurance cover for this visit
limit.waiting: Waiting for the payer to answer a request for {{amount}}.
limit.refused: The payer did not approve this request.

warning.near: The bill is near the approved limit. Ask the payer for more before it passes.
warning.reached: The bill has reached the approved limit. The patient pays what is above it.

split.heading: Split between the patient and the payer
split.terms: {{payer}}, {{plan}}: the patient pays {{percent}}% of what is covered.

reason.service_limit: Above the limit for this service

split.empty: There are no charges to split yet.
split.reconciled: The split adds up to the charges
split.notReconciled: The split does not add up to the charges
split.stale: The charges have changed since the split was saved. Save it again before billing from it.
